name: Undercroft
summary: In the southwestern hills of the Eastern Plaguelands, undead trolls have taken an old Lordaeron tomb. Zaeldarr the Outcast commands them, and a false grave in the catacombs bears Tirion Fordring’s name.

sections.title: A Desecrated Sepulcher
sections.body: You find the Undercroft carved into the bluffs southwest of Corin's Crossing. Lordaeron built it for its honored dead, but the kingdom's fall left the tomb open to undead trolls. Zaeldarr the Outcast leads them from its underground halls. They stalk the Plaguelands and raid the grave pits at Light's Hope Chapel, taking newly buried corpses for their grim practices.

sections.title: A Pretender's Tomb
sections.body: A false grave in the Undercroft bears Tirion Fordring's name. After his trial for treason and exile, Tirion's allies arranged a symbolic burial. This let his family keep their standing while he went into hiding. A personal memento from Tirion's past lies hidden within the grave, where only those who know the truth would search.

faq.answer: Undercroft lies in the southwestern Eastern Plaguelands. Lordaeron built the burial crypt for its nobility and fallen soldiers, but undead horrors occupy it now.
Undead trolls occupy the crypt under Zaeldarr the Outcast, a massive undead dire troll. They use its tunnels as a lair between raids across the region.

faq.q: Why are there undead trolls in the Eastern Plaguelands?
faq.answer: Troll tribes such as the Mossflayer and Witherbark dwell near northern Lordaeron, where the Scourge chiefly raised humans and elves. Undead trolls like Zaeldarr and his followers roam the bluffs. They pillage burial sites and prey on unwary travelers.

faq.q: Why is Tirion Fordring's name on a grave here?
faq.answer: Tirion Fordring's grave at Undercroft is false. After the Alliance of Lordaeron stripped him of rank and exiled him, his allies arranged a mock burial. His family could preserve their honor while he hid in secret.

faq.q: Why do the Undercroft trolls raid Light's Hope Chapel?
faq.answer: Zaeldarr the Outcast leads raids on the grave pits outside Light's Hope Chapel to steal newly buried corpses. His band uses them to bolster its ranks or feed its morbid appetites.

angles.text: As a paladin, you find Tirion Fordring's tragic mock burial at Undercroft, alongside Zaeldarr's brood desecrating sacred crypts.
As a troll, you may see Zaeldarr and his undead kindred as a grim mockery of troll traditions and the sacred rites owed to the dead.
